verses.ar:
Kerdo Kerdo Karam Murshid-E-Mohtaram
Tum Ko Bhaija Gaya Hai Karam K Liyeah
verses.en:
Bestow, bestow your mercy, O Revered Murshid
You were sent for the very purpose of mercy

verses.ar:
Charaagh-E-Chisth Shah-E-Auliya Ghareeb Nawaaz
Bahaar-E-Anjum-E-Mustafa Ghareeb Nawaaz
Khawaja-E-Khawajgan Haami-E-Bekasa
Iljita Sun Lo Shah-E-Umam K Liyeah
verses.en:
Lamp of the Chishti order, King of Saints, Patron of the poor
Bloom of the stars of Mustafa ﷺ, Patron of the poor
O Master of Masters, protector of the helpless
Hear this plea, O King of Nations

verses.ar:
Kerdo Kerdo Karam Mere Khuwaja Piya
Ger Tum Na Karo Gay To Karam Kaun Karay Ga
Jhooli Meri Tumhare Siwa Kaun Bharay Ga
Mere Khuwaja Piya Kerdo Kerdo Karam
verses.en:
Bestow, bestow your mercy, O my beloved Khwaja
If you do not show mercy, then who will?
Who besides you will fill my empty vessel?
O my beloved Khwaja, bestow, bestow your mercy

verses.ar:
Tera Karam Nahi To Qayamat Hai Zindagi
Tera Karam Ho Jab To Salaamt Hai Zindagi
verses.en:
Without your mercy, life is like Judgement Day
When your mercy comes, life is safe and whole

verses.ar:
Hai Tumhari Talab Haasil-E-Bandagi
Is Say Barh Ker Nahi Hai Ibadat Koi
Mere Sajday Hein Ey Khuwaja Hind-Al-Wali
Bus Tumhare He Naqsh-E-Qadam K Liyeah
verses.en:
Seeking you is the very fruit of devotion
There is no worship greater than this
My prostrations, O Khwaja, Protector of Hind
Are only for the sake of your blessed footsteps

verses.ar:
Noor-E-Shah-E-Najaf Mere Khuwaja Piya
Tere Chaukhat Pay Waliyon Nai Sajda Kia
Khaaliq-E-Dojahaan Say Yeah Rutba Mila
Tere Darbaar Faiz-O-Karam K Liyeah
verses.en:
Light of the King of Najaf, O my beloved Khwaja
At your threshold the saints themselves have prostrated
This rank was granted by the Creator of both worlds
Your court exists for the purpose of grace and mercy

verses.ar:
Shah-E-Ajmer Mera Masiha Hai Tu
Dard Mandoon Ke Dukh Ka Madawa Hai Tu
Teri Nisbat Ka Daman Rahay Haath Mein
Bus Dawa Hai Yeah He Ranj-O-Gham K Liyeah
verses.en:
O King of Ajmer, you are my healer
You are the remedy for the pain of the suffering
May the hem of your connection remain in my hand
For this alone is the cure for all grief and sorrow

verses.ar:
Kamraan Hath Hai Sayyad-E-Mehrbaan
Hai Tera Kaam Khuwaja Khata Poshiyan
Laaj Rakhna Fana Ki Moeen-E-Jahaan
Hashr Mein Taajdaar-E-Haram K Liyeah
verses.en:
Kamraan's hand is held by the merciful Sayyid
Your work, O Khwaja, is to conceal the faults of others
Uphold the honour of Fana, O Helper of the World
On the Day of Judgement, for the sake of the King of the Haram
